title: Enterprise Connectivity: approved correction assessment
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this approved correction assessment rule to assisted correction posting.

## Basis: corrected subtotal
For assisted correction posting, read net service subtotal only from the selected assessment with that exact selected original charge, status approved, decision incorrect and cause unit-price error; pending reviews and all other reviews contribute zero.
